RENEWING A MATERIAL'S GEOMETRIC REFERENCE UNDER LOAD
1 November 2026. Fresh physical-technology investigation.

STATUS AND PRECISE OBJECTIVE

The intended consequence is precision structures that can replace worn material
without gradually forgetting their stress-free geometry. Such a capability would
matter for machines, instruments, manufactured infrastructure and eventually
actively maintained materials. This investigation does not establish a
civilisation-changing technology, historical priority, or a complete resource
advantage. It develops and tests a conditional physical construction, eliminates
several attractive shortcuts, and makes the remaining reference-maintenance
problem quantitative.

The positive construction copies a member's NATURAL LENGTH, while it is carrying
load, from two current surviving members. It uses force comparison, a finite
physical observation protocol, and powered rest-length adjustment. No particular
member must remain an intact geometric master. The initial target information
still resides in manufactured physical references; it has not been created from
fuel. Junctions, controller, delivery equipment, sensors and actuators have finite
costs and failure channels. Full autonomous replacement of all of that equipment
is NOT supplied by the member-level construction.

Three scopes must remain distinct:
  (a) exact conditional mathematics and finite-state/linear-model calculations;
  (b) executable numerical evidence using declared, mostly illustrative parameters;
  (c) experimental material performance, which was not acquired.

The earlier sensor and thermal-mediator research is preserved unchanged in the
prior archive. No quantum-information capability is the objective of this run.


1. FIRST CANDIDATE AND WHY IT WAS NOT SELECTED

Before targeted primary or Astra retrieval, the candidate was a heterogeneous
material with geometry-dependent protection of reversible bonds. Locally correct
closure would protect a part; strained or incompatible closure would leave it
exchangeable. Chemical fuel could drive replacement. The root recorded this in
materials_candidate_first_principles.txt. An independent constructor received the
capability and physical constraints, not this preferred mechanism.

MATERIAL REFERENCE RENEWAL UNDER LOAD
Astra physical-technology investigation — 1 November 2026

RESULT

The capability sought is a precision material or structure whose load-bearing
parts can turn over without the object forgetting its original stress-free
geometry. This run develops a force-based reference-copying construction, its
finite observer, relative calibration, actuator work, accumulated copying error,
and a precision-versus-exposure boundary. It also constructs and executes strong
conventional alternatives.

This is not a demonstrated new material, a historical-priority claim, or an
established civilisation-changing advance. A complete resource advantage over a
retained coded specification plus calibrated replacement was not established.
The positive capability and the failures are preserved for further invention.

READ FIRST

PROOF.txt is the complete ordinary derivation, including assumptions and scope.
SOURCES.txt records primary literature, exact public-code provenance and the
selectively used Astra sources with governing conditions.

Principal conclusions:

1. Geometry-only repair cannot determine chemically distinct but geometrically
   indistinguishable target arrangements. Fuel without physical selectivity does
   not fix this.
2. In redundant elastic paths, force differences can identify natural-length
   differences under unknown common loading. A finite balance and relative
   calibration can realize a conditional copying operation.
3. A complete finite two-polarity Gaussian observer removes unknown constant
   offset and initial-state nuisances at the calibrated meter response. Its exact
   finite covariance includes endpoint readout noise and temporal correlation.
4. Repeated independent analog copying makes the common reference diffuse even
   when disagreement contracts. In the specified three-member cyclic protocol,
   Var(R_M)=(4/3) M sigma_copy^2. Bias accumulates linearly.
5. Observing longer reduces copying noise but exposes remaining load paths.

SOURCE CONDITIONS AND PROVENANCE
Research date: 1 November 2026

The root first-principles candidate is preserved separately. Literature and Astra
were retrieved after that candidate and used to challenge it. The independent
constructor initially received the capability and physical constraints without
the root's proposed mechanism. Source claims below are narrower than an integrated
demonstration of the proposed material. None establishes this run's priority.

1. PRIMARY SELF-ASSEMBLY AND REPAIR RESEARCH

Soloveichik, Cook and Winfree, Combining Self-Healing and Proofreading in
Self-Assembly (2007/2008), DOI 10.1007/s11047-007-9036-x.
https://authors.library.caltech.edu/records/7gj5t-g0873
The independent report records seed protection, idealized interactions and
kinetic/concentration conditions. This is a strong algorithmic construction,
not a generic chemistry-independent repair oracle.

Scheckenbach et al., Self-Regeneration and Self-Healing of DNA Origami
Nanostructures (2021), DOI 10.1002/anie.202012986.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7986372/
Replacement staples can restore portions of a DNA-origami structure; the original
scaffold remains a reference. The experimental scope matters for total turnover.

Zhu et al., Proofreading mechanism for colloidal self-assembly (2024),
Physical Review Research 6, L042057.
https://journals.aps.org/prresearch/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.6.L042057

https://github.com/brennergroup/paper_notebooks/blob/main/Proofreading_self_assembly.ipynb

molecular environment detector or a physically implemented fuel cycle.
